pageServer.authGuard: locals.user?.id verified on SSR load and all mutation actions; redirects 302 to /login on missing session
uploadActionFlow: File validation: file.size, file.type in ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES, file.name check
Upload raw file buffer to SeaweedFS ('legal-evidence' bucket)
Insert metadata row into public.evidence table
Generate 24h presigned preview URL and return success

apiEndpoint.pipeline: Full synchronous and queued OCR, chunking, entity extraction, strict llama-server :8081 EmbeddingGemma 768-D embedding, and persistEvidenceVectorForProjectionV1() transactional outbox commit.

fileSizeLimitMismatch.recommendation: Unify to shared constant in src/lib/server/evidence/evidence-upload-contract.ts (default 50MB, or configurable via env).

schemaFieldParity.superformsSchema: { title: z.string().min(1).max(256), description: z.string().max(5000).optional(), caseId: z.string().uuid().optional() }
schemaFieldParity.recommendation: Add optional evidenceType to evidenceUploadSchema in routes/(app)/evidence/schema.ts.

persistenceSeparation.rule: Superforms action owns S3 upload and evidence row creation; vector persistence is strictly owned by persistEvidenceVectorForProjectionV1() via the processing pipeline. No duplicate vector insertion in form action.
